description_en: Invokes DescribeDedicatedHostTypes to query the detailed parameters of dedicated host types supported in a specified region, or queries the ECS instance families supported by dedicated hosts
description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostTypes查询指定地域下支持的专有宿主机规格详细参数，或者查询专有宿主机支持的ECS实例规格族
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-dedicated-host-types --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-type ddh.sn1ne --supported-instance-type-family ecs.sn1ne --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHostTypes

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the dedicated host. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
